_doc: Place name -> country, for a posting whose location names a town and no country. Built by app/scripts/gen-places.ts from GeoNames (geonames.org, CC-BY 4.0) - regenerate, do not hand-edit. `places[name]` indexes `countries`: the first is where the name sends a posting (its most populous city of 15 000+, or a first-level region only one country has), the rest are every other country with a place of that spelling, which is the veto - an employer whose own country is among them keeps its answer. Keys are lower-case with the accents folded off. `codes` are the two-letter state and canton abbreviations, which only ever choose between the countries a town already names.
